text:
Morgan: Heads-up: PR #4837 has updated SDK snippets for v0.12 and fixes a few broken links. Need reviewers + a merge slot before the feature flag cutoff Friday EOD. Anyone available?

Kevin: I'll review today. Is the docs preview working? last build failed.

CI-bot: ci/docs-preview: failed — linkcheck error in networking.md:42
```
ERROR: broken link https://internal-gist.company.com/snippet -> networking.md:42
``` 

Morgan: Ah, that was the internal gist. I replaced it with the canonical snippet and pushed a fix (force-pushed with -f since I rebased).

Sam: gave a quick skim, code samples look good. I left one nit in the python example. @Tara do you want to review the migration wording for 0.12?

Tara: I can take it. Quick note: we agreed docs shouldn't land until the release branch cutover unless it's a doc-only non-breaking wording change. When is the cutoff?

Morgan: Release branch cutover is tomorrow 10:00 UTC. There's an afternoon merge window at 14:00 UTC that's usually safe for docs-only PRs. Can we aim for that? 

Kevin: I'll try to get the LGTM by 13:30 UTC. If the linkcheck still fails locally run:
```
# from repo root
mkdocs build && python tools/check_links.py --max-redirects 5
```

renderbot: Preview published: https://deploy-preview.redwood-inference.io/4837 (expires in 2 days) :rocket:

Morgan: Preview looks good. Fixed the python snippet per Sam's nit. No new failures on my local `make linkcheck`.

CI-bot: ci/docs-preview: success — all checks passed ✅

Kevin: LGTM. I'll queue for the 14:00 UTC merge slot. Please add a short release-note blurb in the PR description re: SDK snippet change.

Morgan: Done — added release note and changelog line. @deploy-bot can you schedule merge?

deploy-bot: Merge scheduled: PR #4837 will merge at 14:00:00 UTC into main if no regressions. If conflicts arise, it will be moved to next available slot.

Sam: :thumbsup: Thanks everyone — this resolves the link flakiness in the migration guide.

Tara: Approved. :white_check_mark:

Morgan: Thanks all. I'll follow up if anything blocks the release cutover.
